containers.name: prod
containers.description: Root of the prod HDFS environment.

containers.name: datalake
containers.description: Datalake job outputs, grouped by job name.

containers.name: scheduler_service_journal_data_extraction
containers.description: Output files from the scheduler_service_journal_data_extraction Airflow DAG. Files land under a daily YYYYMMDD subfolder, e.g. 20260907/.

containers.name: schedule_action_output
containers.description: Straight HBase extraction of schedule-action, no transform. One file per day: schedule_action_output_<yyyy-mm-dd>.csv, e.g. schedule_action_output_2026-09-07.csv.

columns.name: x_request_id
columns.description: Cross-system request identifier

columns.name: x_job_id
columns.description: Cross-system job identifier

columns.name: running_date
columns.description: Date the action actually ran

columns.name: execution_time_id
columns.description: Identifier for the scheduled execution time slot

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier

columns.name: service_id
columns.description: Identifier for the scheduled service instance

columns.name: chrono_sequence_journal
columns.description: Chronological sequence journal identifier

columns.name: action
columns.description: Action type/status code, e.g. C (created), U (updated)

columns.name: new_service_name
columns.description: Name of the downstream service invoked, e.g. ACCOUNT

columns.name: new_status
columns.description: Current status of the action, e.g. pending, done

columns.name: new_execution_start_datetime
columns.description: Timestamp execution started, with timezone offset

columns.name: new_execution_finish_datetime
columns.description: Timestamp execution finished, with timezone offset

columns.name: new_effective_date
columns.description: Effective date for the (re)scheduled action

columns.name: new_result
columns.description: Execution result, e.g. fail

columns.name: new_error_code
columns.description: Error code returned on failure

columns.name: new_error_desc
columns.description: Error description returned on failure

columns.name: new_thread
columns.description: Thread/worker count or identifier handling the action

columns.name: new_chronological_sequence
columns.description: Updated chronological sequence value

columns.name: new_execution_count
columns.description: Number of times this action has been executed

columns.name: new_transaction_job_id
columns.description: Job identifier for the underlying transaction

columns.name: new_system_note
columns.description: Free-text system note, often empty

columns.name: new_is_timeout
columns.description: Whether the action timed out

columns.name: new_elapsed_time
columns.description: Elapsed execution time in milliseconds

columns.name: last_updated_datetime
columns.description: Timestamp this record was last updated, with timezone offset

columns.name: last_updated_description
columns.description: Free-text description of the last update event

columns.name: last_updated_user_id
columns.description: User or system that performed the last update, e.g. INTERNAL

columns.name: last_updated_other_info
columns.description: Additional structured info about the last update
